name: Brooke Rollins

lean.basis: Led the conservative Texas Public Policy Foundation, served in Trump's first White House, founded the America First Policy Institute, and is his agriculture secretary.

summary: Brooke Rollins ran the conservative Texas Public Policy Foundation before joining Trump's White House in 2018 to lead the Office of American Innovation, which Jared Kushner oversaw, and served as acting director of the Domestic Policy Council in 2020–2021. In 2021 she co-founded the America First Policy Institute with Linda McMahon and Larry Kudlow and led it until becoming agriculture secretary in 2025.
